reason: Reproduced with installed uv 0.13.6 on Ubuntu 24.04.5 Linux x86_64, CPython 3.12.3. In a short temporary directory, created a dependency-free local wheel exposing tab-probe, then ran: uv venv --python /usr/bin/python3 $'tab\tdir/venv'; uv pip install --python $'tab\tdir/venv/bin/python' ./tab_probe-1.0-py3-none-any.whl; $'tab\tdir/venv/bin/tab-probe'. Creation and installation succeeded, but launcher execution returned ENOENT; Bash exited 127 with 'cannot execute: required file not found'. The generated 48-byte direct shebang contained a literal tab and no spaces. Explicitly invoking the environment's Python on the launcher succeeded. Plain-path and space-plus-tab controls also succeeded; the latter received a shell wrapper. This confirms the reported tab-path launch failure, not arbitrary shell execution. Updated $RUNNER_TEMP/issue-context/README.md with evidence, commands, and inspected test coverage. No checkout or GitHub changes were made.
